title: My Friend's House
text:
My friend Ana has a small house. The house is blue and it has two windows. There is a big garden behind the house. Ana likes to sit in the garden with her cat.

Inside the house, the kitchen is yellow. There is a large table in the kitchen. The bedrooms are upstairs. Ana's room is very bright because it has a big window.

questions.text: Why is Ana's room probably bright?
What kind of person is Ana probably?
options: A person who likes nature and animals
A person who does not like animals
A person who lives alone in a big city
A person who never goes outside

vocabulary.definition: an area outside a house with plants and grass
the room where you cook food

vocabulary.translation: em cima, no andar de cima
vocabulary.definition: on a higher floor of a building

paragraph_translations: Minha amiga Ana tem uma casa pequena. A casa é azul e tem duas janelas. Há um jardim grande atrás da casa. Ana gosta de sentar no jardim com o seu gato.
Dentro da casa, a cozinha é amarela. Há uma mesa grande na cozinha. Os quartos ficam em cima. O quarto da Ana é muito claro porque tem uma janela grande.
